period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header 'January 01 to September 30, 2012' (the filing also separately shows a discrete 'July 01 to September 30' 3-month column, not used here). Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (3rd_quarter_2012.pdf) is a native digital PDF with a clean pdftotext -layout extraction; figures cross-verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 100,246,378,884 + Total Equity 11,125,182,285 = Total Assets 111,371,561,169); Profit before tax 1,334,619,052 - Provision for tax 943,707,997 = Profit after tax 390,911,055, matching the filing's own EPS of 0.56. Cross-check: comparative 'December 31, 2011' column (Total Assets BDT 103,510.70mn, Total Equity BDT 11,583.80mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2011_Q4.json exactly. VALIDATION NOTE: cumulative Profit after tax DECREASES from BDT 456.83mn at H1 2012 (see 2012_Q2.json) to BDT 390.91mn here at 9M 2012 -- investigated and confirmed genuine, not a transcription error: the filing's own discrete 'July 01 to September 30, 2012' column reports a standalone net LOSS after tax of BDT (65,920,806) for that single quarter (456,831,861 - 65,920,806 = 390,911,055, ties exactly), driven by a discrete-quarter Provision for tax of BDT 441,557,223 against discrete-quarter Profit before tax of only BDT 375,636,417 -- i.e. a genuine one-quarter earnings dip, not a data error.
